title: Complexity of the halting problem for Eulerian multigraphs
exact_target: Can termination of chip firing on Eulerian graphs with binary-encoded parallel edges be decided in polynomial time?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 3000017 (AMR-029-0017). CC BY 4.0.
B. Hujter, V. Kiss and L. Tóthmérész, On the complexity of the chip-firing reachability problem (2017), Sections 1 and 2.1--2.4; Section 5, Problems 19 and 22, pp.12--13.
